clips.title: The story
paras: Across the Barrens, zhevras graze in the open savannah. Their hooves prove a hunter can face swift, powerful prey.

Zhevras graze across the Barrens, but their compact, muscular legs can strike hard. Sergra Darkthorn, the orc shaman in charge of the Crossroads, sends aspiring Horde scouts to gather hooves from zhevra runners. The hunt sharpens a fledgling hunter's instincts and resilience. A panicked runner can kick even a sturdy tauren flat. Intact hooves show a hunter can handle swift, kicking quarry before taking on Kalimdor's deadliest predators.
